title: Giving Up an Equipment Rental and Demo Reservation Before Collection
content:
A guest may give a reservation up before the kit is collected. Kit already collected is never cancelled; it is handed in, and the days already used stand.

## The deadline

A cancellation carries no fee only when it is recorded on or before the free cancellation deadline, which is the package's free cancellation period measured back from the start of the collection date. The notice period is measured in whole elapsed hours on the shop's local clock and is subtracted from the start of the collection date to give the deadline; elapsed hours are never mixed with calendar days, and an hour begun is not an hour elapsed. A cancellation recorded at the deadline itself is on the deadline and carries no fee.

The collection date is the one written on the agreement as the collective's records carry it, and the notice figure is the one held against the package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line the reservation is written on.

### The deadline on hypothetical hours

Take a package whose free cancellation period is 24 whole hours and a reservation whose collection date is the 14th of February. The start of the collection date is midnight at the opening of the 14th, and 24 whole hours back from it is midnight at the opening of the 13th. A cancellation recorded at that midnight is on the deadline and carries no fee; one recorded at one in the morning on the 13th is after it, and the package's cancellation share is retained.

## What comes back

| The reservation is given up | What happens to the money |
| --- | --- |
| on or before the deadline | the whole agreement value comes back and the security hold is released |
| after the deadline | the package's cancellation share of the agreement value is retained and the rest comes back |
| never, and the kit is never collected | once the hold period has run out the reservation is treated as uncollected, and the package's uncollected share is retained instead |
| where the collective cannot supply kit of the right size, or the mountain does not open | nothing is retained and the whole agreement value comes back, whenever the cancellation is recorded |

The last row stands whatever the deadline says: a cancellation recorded long after the deadline still returns the whole agreement value where the collective could not supply kit of the right size or the mountain did not open.

## Points of judgement

**A guest who simply does not appear.** Where the guest never collects the kit and never cancels, the reservation is treated as uncollected once the package's hold period has run out, and it is the uncollected share rather than the cancellation share that is retained.

**A guest who has the kit in hand.** Once the kit is collected there is no cancellation. The kit is handed in, and the days already used stand.
